title: Open Duck Mini skill package: skill.json
description: One versioned skill in skills/<name>/v<N>/. The other files of the package (clip.json, policy.onnx, report/battery.json) are required by tools/skill_package.py validate; this schema covers skill.json only.

name.description: Folder name under skills/. Lower-case snake case.

commands.description: Runtime inputs and the ranges they were trained over: {input: [min, max]}. Empty for a skill that takes only a trigger.

from.description: Skills this one may be entered from.

phase.description: Gait phase window [lo, hi] (fraction of the locomotion cycle) in which the hand-off may start.

window_s.description: Length of the reference-level blend into this skill.

to.description: Skills this one may hand off to.

neighbours.description: Every skill named in entry.from or exit.to. The motion graph loader checks each exists and passed its battery.

timeout_s.description: Longest the skill may run before the engine aborts to recovery. null = no timeout (locomotion); an episodic skill must have one.

torque_nm.description: Servo torque ceiling the battery passed under (deployable 1.86 N.m).

thermal_c.description: Servo temperature above which the runtime must not start this skill.

fall_tilt_deg.description: Trunk tilt that counts as a fall in the battery and the runtime.

actuator_model_version.description: Mechatronics' actuator model id, e.g. bam-sts3215-2025.09.

recipe_version.description: Training recipe id (frozen reward template + randomisation), or 'legacy-joystick' for brains from before the recipe.

names.description: Ordered observation blocks. Known names: tools/skillkit.BLOCK_SIZES.

size.description: Total observation dimension; must equal the ONNX input width.

blocks.description: Optional per-block sizes when they differ from the defaults.

runtime.description: How actions become servo targets. Defaults are the deployed walk's.

head_mode.description: add: head = policy + head command (upstream runtime); from_cmd: head = home + command (HEAD_FROM_CMD brains).

episodic_cmd.description: Velocity command held while an episodic clip plays.

thresholds.description: Battery and sim-to-sim pass criteria; defaults in tools/skillkit.DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.

clip.description: Where clip.json came from (path or tool).

run.description: Training run folder or the ONNX the package was built from.
